correctness.rationale: Each unmatched man–woman pair contributes at most one rank-before-match incidence, else it blocks, so Σ(r_a-1)≤n(n−1), hence L≤floor((n+1)/2). For n≤4, L≤2; at n=5 any stable matching with L=3 has all ten ranks 3 and is simultaneously gap- and regret-optimal (a hypothetical all-ranks≤2 stable matching would block it). Otherwise choose among min-regret matchings a min-gap one with R=q; all others have R≥q+1 and L≤2, hence gap≥q−1≥chosen gap. An independently written direct checker enumerated all 720 perfect matchings of supplied six-pair witness, exactly seven stable, with unique min gap (2,5) identity and unique min regret (3,4) matching (1,0,2,3,4,5). Complete universal n≤5 follows from incidence proof, not the 720-case check. Read verify_independent.py and RESULT.md frozen blobs.
